texts.zh:
在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的外星设计的建筑。尽管它已经老化，我们的科学家还是确定这一巨型结构实际上是几个造船船坞的组合体——一个巨型船坞。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识和工业能力，我们的生产能力将会极大地提升。
texts.en:
In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast structure of alien design. Despite its decrepit state, our scientists confirms that the megastructure is in fact a combination of several construction yards - a Mega Shipyard.

If we were to acquire the knowledge on how to repair this magnificent, industrial facility, our production capabilities would increase immensely.

texts.zh: 在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的巨型船坞结构——和我们建造的设计相似。尽管其已老化无法使用，但只需充足的资源，我们应该就能将其恢复至运作状态！
texts.en: In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast Mega Shipyard structure - similar to that of our own design. The megastructure is in a decrepit state, however, and needs extensive repairs in order to be brought back online.

summary.text:
# 巨型船坞 / Mega Shipyard

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/11_mega_shipyard.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Federations（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工巨型船坞（见 common/megastructures/11_mega_shipyard.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Mega Shipyard inside your borders (common/megastructures/11_mega_shipyard.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. feda.1：框架建成（mega_shipyard_1） / Framework built (mega_shipyard_1)
2. feda.2：核心建成（mega_shipyard_2） / Core built (mega_shipyard_2)
3. feda.3：巨型船坞上线（mega_shipyard_3） / Mega Shipyard online (mega_shipyard_3)

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- 无（该巨型结构不向其他帝国发送专门通知）/ none (this megastructure sends no dedicated notices to other empires)
- 废墟 The ruin：feda.5（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_mega_shipyard_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；feda.6 在修复完成后出现。
  feda.5 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). feda.6 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.


## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/11_mega_shipyard.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
